tanvi (PM): Morning. Last sync before Observe canary. Need final scope decision on sampling defaults, per-tenant opt-ins, dashboard acceptance, and rollback triggers.

eli (Eng): TL;DR: safe defaults + tenant opt-in required for full error traces. Engineering plan: runtime sampling tree + per-tenant override + global cap. Risk: bursty errors cause write IO spikes.

frank (SRE): Saw this pattern in staging. With 10% canary we saw trace writes spike ~8x during error storm. Immediate mitigations we want: async buffer + bounded queue + auto-throttle.

nora (Eng-Platform): Proposed config (canary defaults):
```yaml
observe_sampling:
  default_success: 0.5
  default_error: 100
  tenant_overrides: true
  global_cap_per_region: 180
```
Tenant override requires explicit consent flag tenant.observe_full_traces = true.

aline (Solutions): Customer ask summary: Acme wants full traces for postmortems but only for incidents they opt into. FinSecure will only allow redacted traces; they need a signed attestation before we enable.

eli (Eng): Implementation notes: token-bucket limiter at ingress to enforce global_cap_per_region. We'll instrument a metric `observe.limiter.dropped` and expose it to the gating dashboard.

frank (SRE): Gate criteria to pass canary -> 50% (proposed):
- dashboards: error-by-model & route tile present and updates within 3m
- sampling: `observe.limiter.dropped` == 0 for normal traffic and < 5/min during error spikes
- redaction: finsecure redact tests pass (no account_id/email in traces)
- perf: p95 console api latency <= 630ms
- ops: trace_queue_len < 4000 and trace_write_latency_p95 < 350ms
- cost: rolling-2h cost delta <= 12% vs baseline

tanvi (PM): Also add auto-rollback rule: if trace_queue_len > 5k OR p95 latency increase > 15% sustained 5m -> rollback flag, paging SRE.

aline (Solutions): For customer opt-in UX: we'll ship a tenant flag and a consent email template. Also provide `GET /tenant/{id}/observe-status` to show current sampling and redaction state.

nora (Eng-Platform): We'll add redact_rules env like REDACT_RULES=["email","account_id","ssn"]. Unit tests for sanitizer will run in CI and we'll include a canary-only end-to-end test.

eli (Eng): Action list: eli = token-bucket limiter + metrics, nora = redact + tenant flag API + cost emitter, frank = synthetic error storm test + gating monitor, tanvi = dashboard gating board + customer comms, aline = customer opt-in templates. ETA: EOD.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled 14:20 PT -> rolling 10% traffic.

frank (SRE): I'll run a 40m synthetic with two phases: steady 200rps and then error spike to simulate incident. We'll post results here.

tanvi (PM): Rollout plan: canary (10%) -> 40m observe -> evaluate gates -> 50% if green for 2h -> post-mortem and then full rollout. If any gate fails, immediate rollback to previous flag state.

eli (Eng): Added smoke test in PR: validates header propagation, sampling decision, and redact sanitizer. I'll paste PR link when CI passes.

tanvi (PM): Please drop the gating dashboard link, synthetic logs, and PR links here during canary. This thread is canonical for launch decisions. Thanks :rocket:
